# GeoKnight GIS
> GeoKnight GIS (GeoKnight Geospatial Information Services), based in Jacksonville, Florida and serving clients anywhere, builds custom GIS web applications: interactive web maps, dashboards and map-based tools for businesses and government. Services are quoted before work begins: custom maps and dashboards; data preparation and automation, including integrations that connect maps to existing systems (CRM, permitting, asset or work-order systems, databases, APIs and data syncs); and managed hosting and maintenance, quoted monthly based on scope. If you have your own hosting or IT team, compatibility and deployment responsibilities are confirmed before work begins. GeoKnight GIS keeps its code; the client receives the finished deliverable and a license to use it. Founded by Christopher Knight, GIS & Data Engineer.
